baseline_models.mechanism: The alerting sight frame asks for reflective recognition of a layered causal chain: divine release, rebel intermediaries, truth-concealing recipients, and sustained boiling agitation.

activation_trace.role: The alerting-inquiry branch makes the opening a demand to recognize an otherwise hidden arrangement.
The alternate mapped deliberation branch adds reflective assessment without replacing the surface sense of seeing.
Release or dispatch, including letting loose against restraint, supplies the governing action.
The rebellious-agent branch identifies the dispatched intermediaries as active insubordinate forces.
Concealment of truth defines the recipient class by its active blockage rather than a neutral label.
Boiling that emits a hiss supplies sustained internal excitation and makes the cognate intensifier dynamically forceful.

changed_reading.after: The ayah discloses a governed allocation of agencies in which released rebel forces keep truth-concealing recipients in an intensified, boiling state.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَرْسَلْنَا ٱلشَّيَاطِينَ عَلَى ٱلْكَافِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّا
baseline_models.mechanism: Successive dispatch, plural agents, the placement عَلَى, and the crowding branch of أزّ combine into recurring bands of pressure that narrow the target collective's room for independent movement.

activation_trace.role: Successive flocks or groups turn dispatch into repeated arrivals rather than one isolated intervention.
Deviation, crookedness, and severity give the arriving plural agents a directional pressure against the target.
Packing bodies together until space contracts supplies the social-spatial effect of the repeated pressure.

changed_reading.before: The action is a single episode of inward suggestion.
changed_reading.after: The action can be read as a recurrent pressure field: successive deviant forces are added over a collective until its behavioral space contracts.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired sight prompts frame a local forensic arc: a truth-concealing speaker voices confidence in future wealth and offspring, his saying is recorded while its consequence is extended, and he comes alone; the focus prompt then exposes agitation behind such confident speech.

activation_trace.role: The first alerting sight prompt opens the case that the focus sight prompt later re-reads.
Saying as belief or position makes the boast a committed orientation, not only emitted words.
An extended term holds the speaker's consequence open through time while the claim remains recorded.
The solitary branch strips the boastful speaker of the wealth, offspring, and social reinforcement he projected.
The renewed alerting prompt shifts attention from the visible boast to its hidden pressure mechanism.
Boiling excitation supplies a possible pressure beneath the speaker's assured surface.

structural_cues: 19:77 أَفَرَءَيْتَ and 19:83 أَلَمْ تَرَ form paired sight prompts around the local sequence.
The run moves from projected wealth and offspring through recorded speech and extension to solitary arrival, then names demonic agitation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the paired prompts and the sequence boast → inscription and extension → solitude → focus; I infer that 19:83 diagnoses pressure behind the boast, while the live alternative is that it generalizes beyond this speaker without explaining his speech specifically.

changed_reading.before: 19:83 gives a generic description of a class unrelated to the preceding boast.
changed_reading.after: 19:83 can function as the disclosure requested by 19:77: apparent self-assurance is re-read as speech produced within an unseen field of agitation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Extension before the focus and prohibition of haste plus counting after it place demonic agitation inside a measured interval: the targets are accelerated internally while their allotted time is lengthened and enumerated externally.

activation_trace.role: Lengthened time supplies the outer interval within which agitation operates.
Intensifying boil supplies the targets' urgent inner tempo.
Speeding and bringing forward names the haste explicitly refused to the addressee.
Exact enumeration supplies the controlled outer tempo opposed to agitation.
The later repeated enumeration confirms that the measured clock reaches individual accounting.

structural_cues: 19:79 نَمُدُّ ... مَدًّا, 19:83 تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّا, and 19:84 نَعُدُّ ... عَدًّا align intensified verb-verbal-noun pairs.
The direct prohibition فَلَا تَعْجَلْ follows the focus ayah, while counting recurs in 19:94.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies extension, intensified agitation, refused haste, and repeated counting; I assign them an inner-clock versus outer-clock relation, while the live alternative is that the haste command addresses only the messenger and does not describe the targets' temporality.

changed_reading.after: أزّ marks subjective acceleration inside an objectively extended and exactly counted interval: pressure urges them forward without shortening the countdown.

context_deltas.mechanism: Adopted powers are intended to furnish reinforcement, then disavow worship and become an opposing force; the next ayah's demonic pressure occupies the relational space left by that reversal, turning sought patronage into hostile propulsion.

activation_trace.role: Strengthening and reinforcement name the benefit the adopted powers were meant to provide.
Disavowal and renunciation reverse the expected alliance from within.
Contrary opposition converts former supports into forces facing their clients.
Rebellious agents supply the active hostile force that follows the failed patronage.
Boiling agitation renders the reversed relation as active pressure rather than mere absence of help.

structural_cues: The purpose clause لِيَكُونُوا لَهُمْ عِزًّا reverses in the next ayah to وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا.
The tight sequence عِزًّا → ضِدًّا → أَزًّا and عَلَيْهِمْ → عَلَى binds desired support, opposition, and pressure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intended reinforcement, explicit disavowal and opposition, then pressure upon the same target class; I infer a reversal of outsourced patronage, while the live alternative is that the devils are a distinct group introduced after, not the transformed relation of the adopted powers.

changed_reading.before: The devils attack from a theme independent of the failed gods.
changed_reading.after: Their agitation can be read as the operational reversal of hoped-for honor: outsourced support returns as opposition and pressure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus release and pressure become the upstream motion in a paired transport scene: the guarded are gathered as a delegation toward the Merciful, while the criminals are driven in successive entry toward Hell.

activation_trace.role: Release and dispatch initiate directed movement before the two destination scenes.
Crowding pressure supplies propulsion on the target collective.
Driving a group together toward a destination supplies the first explicit transport pattern.
Arrival before one holding authority gives the guarded group's movement a received-delegation form.
Driving and expelling supply the coercive counterpart appropriate to the pressured class.
Successive entry turns the destination into the endpoint of a continuing driven flow.

structural_cues: 19:85 and 19:86 form parallel plural movements with opposed destinations: إِلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ and إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ.
The focus has dispatch عَلَى a class; the following pair makes class-level motion toward destinations explicit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispatch and pressure followed by matched gathering and driving scenes; I infer that the focus pressure is upstream propulsion toward the criminal route, while the live alternative is that 19:85-86 show only later outcomes rather than continuation of the same motion.

changed_reading.before: Demonic agitation has no spatial or process relation to the following gathering.
changed_reading.after: It can be carried as an early transport force: pressure already moves the covered class toward the coercive route later named as driving.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus supplies boiling and crowding pressure; the later doctrinal utterance assigns offspring, and the text renders that claim as opening, splitting, falling, and resounding fracture. Agitated speech thus becomes a possible relay from hidden pressure to world-scale material stress.

activation_trace.role: Boiling with emitted hiss supplies stored excitation and an acoustic register.
Compression and loss of room supply the pressure side of the later fracture analogy.
Saying as a held doctrine makes the offspring claim the articulated output of an orientation.
A thing represented as generated from another supplies the asserted relation carrying the stress.
Opening and fissure give pressure its first material failure mode.
Splitting open extends the failure across the earth.
A disturbed fall accompanied by sound transfers fracture into mountain collapse.
Severe rumbling gives the collapse the amplified sound-register latent in the focus boil.

structural_cues: 19:88 states the claim, 19:90 uses مِنْهُ for the near-fracture, and 19:91 supplies أَن دَعَوْا as its explanation.
The material sequence descends from heavens opening to earth splitting to mountains falling with a verbal-noun intensifier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies claim → cosmic fracture and earlier supplies demonic agitation; I add the arrow agitation → doctrinal utterance and read the focus pressure as the precursor, while the live alternative is that the claim arises independently and only its consequence is specified.

changed_reading.before: The focus agitation is private temptation with no material scale.
changed_reading.after: It can be read as pressure that becomes articulated doctrine and, once voiced, is represented as stress capable of opening and collapsing the world.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus packs plural agents against plural recipients, but exhaustive enumeration and solitary arrival later decompose that pressured collective into separately answerable persons.

activation_trace.role: Crowding until space contracts supplies the initial collective compaction.
Exhaustive numerical reckoning resolves the packed class without remainder.
Repeated counting makes the decomposition explicit and exact.
The solitary individual is the terminal unit produced from the formerly crowded plurality.

structural_cues: 19:83 uses plural agents, plural recipients, and a plural object pronoun; 19:94-95 move through totalizing pronouns to each one arriving alone.
The repeated cognate accusatives أَزًّا and عَدًّا mark opposite operations: compaction and enumeration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies collective crowding branches followed by exhaustive counting and solitary arrival; I infer a pack → decompose contrast, while the live alternative is that plurality and individuality are compatible emphases without a staged operation.

changed_reading.before: The disbelievers remain an undifferentiated mass under pressure.
changed_reading.after: Demonic pressure may homogenize them behaviorally as a crowd, but the later count reverses that compression by resolving every member into solitary accountability.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines material branches of cover, tether, boiling, and crowding into one analogy. It remains anchored in the focus roots and the construction عَلَى, but downstream prose should call it a pressure-vessel or cinching image, not an etymological definition of unbelief or devils.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies an enclosure around the recipient class.
A long tightly twisted tether supplies a cinching linkage laid over that enclosure.
Boiling and hiss supply rising excitation inside the image.
Packing until the place narrows supplies constriction from outside.

changed_reading.before: Temptation consists only of discrete persuasive messages.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the covered collective resembles a cinched pressure vessel: external packing and internal boiling jointly reduce the possibility of release.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant Q-W-L packet mapping and links nonadjacent sound branches. It remains valid as an activation because the focus azz branch is explicitly acoustic and the endpoint asks whether any faint sound remains; render it only as a form-distant vibratory arc, not lexical equivalence or a proven causal chain.

activation_trace.role: The boiling hiss gives focus agitation an acoustic vibration.
The alternate mapped oscillation branch lets voiced doctrine act, exploratorily, as transmitted disturbance.
Severe rumbling amplifies the disturbance at the cosmic-collapse scene.
Auditory perception sets the final test for whether any signal survives.
A faint hidden sound is the minimal endpoint whose absence closes the acoustic arc.

changed_reading.before: Agitation, utterance, cosmic collapse, and vanished peoples are unrelated sound events.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the sequence traces disturbance from demonic hiss through oscillating doctrine and cosmic rumble to the total absence of even a faint residual sound.

strongest_changes: The عِزًّا → ضِدًّا → أَزًّا chain recasts agitation as the reversal of hoped-for patronage into hostile pressure.
The مَدًّا → أَزًّا → عَدًّا sequence places subjective acceleration inside extended and enumerated time.
Collective crowding is later reversed by exhaustive counting into solitary accountability.
summary.what_was_special: The focus became a controlled pressure-and-transport mechanism rather than a loose temptation theme; packet-provided split mappings also preserved reflective R-W-Y and vibratory Q-L-L as contained, form-distant activations.
remaining_uncertainties: أَرْسَلْنَا supports release or letting loose, but whether downstream prose should stress authorization, permission, or simple dispatch remains open.
The paired sight prompts may diagnose the specific boastful speaker or may only move from one example to a broader class.
The pressure-vessel and acoustic arcs are branch-backed analogies; they should not replace the surface morphology or be stated as settled causation.
